entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
(Sighs) Hi Charlie... I hope you can help. I need to return a helmet I received a couple of months ago. I've been a loyal customer for years, and I'm just so disappointed this didn't work out.
I'm certainly sorry to hear you're disappointed, but I'll do my best to help you. Can I get your name and order number to pull up the account?
Yes, it's Maria Valenti, order 884-215-900. Honestly, I've been so stressed about this. I really needed this money back for some other bills.

I understand completely, Maria. Thank you. I've got your order right here for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet. So I can figure out the best way forward, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the helmet or more of a preference issue?

It's just the color. My husband bought it as a surprise, and it's this bright yellow that I just... I can't stand it. I was so sad about it, I never even took it out of its packaging. The box is still unopened.
Okay, I see. So the item is in brand new condition, just not the color you were hoping for. Let me just take a quick look at the delivery date and our policy for you. Please hold one moment.
Alright, thank you for your patience, Maria. I see the helmet was delivered 66 days ago. Looking at our policy for standard items like this, you are well within the 90-day return window.
Oh, thank goodness! I was so worried I had waited too long. That's a huge relief.

Not at all, you're perfectly fine. We can absolutely get this return started for you. We want to make sure you're happy with your gear. Getting the right helmet is the most important part of cycling safety, and that includes liking how it looks.
Thank you so much, Charlie! You have no idea what a weight this takes off my shoulders. I really appreciate your help.

It's my pleasure, Maria. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email we have on file right now. Just affix that to the shipping box, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, you'll see a full refund in 3-5 business days.
You're very welcome. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been wonderful.
Happy I could help. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
